message.content: {"note_claim": "Blackface specifically applies to one of another race darkening their face to portray a caricature of a black person.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Blackface is the practice of performers using burned cork, shoe polish, or theatrical makeup to portray a racialized caricature of black people, e.g. African Americans, on stage or in entertainment.", "reason": "The Wikipedia page directly defines blackface as the practice of using makeup to portray a racialized caricature of black people, substantiating the note's claim about what blackface specifically applies to."}

parsed.note_claim: Blackface specifically applies to one of another race darkening their face to portray a caricature of a black person.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Blackface is the practice of performers using burned cork, shoe polish, or theatrical makeup to portray a racialized caricature of black people, e.g. African Americans, on stage or in entertainment.
